end.parentNote: Dev practised naming circle parts and relating diameter to radius and chords. Dev first said a circle has four lines of symmetry, then corrected this to infinitely many because every diameter is a line of symmetry; rotational symmetry was also discussed. At home, ask Dev to explain one circle diagram using these terms.
